# azurefilesacl Provider

Provider for managing Windows ACLs on Azure Files objects and Azure Virtual Desktop session-host cleanup operations.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account_key` (String, Sensitive) Storage account key for `account_key` authentication. Intended for prototype, testing, or break-glass use.
- `arm_endpoint` (String) Azure Resource Manager endpoint. Defaults to `https://management.azure.com`.
- `auth_method` (String) Authentication method for Azure Files data-plane calls. Supported values: `oauth`, `sas`, `account_key`. Defaults to `oauth`. For `azurefilesacl_file_acl`, `oauth` can fall back to ARM `listKeys` plus shared-key Azure Files calls if direct bearer-token ACL access is unauthorized.
- `graph_api_version` (String) Microsoft Graph API version. Defaults to `beta`.
- `graph_endpoint` (String) Microsoft Graph endpoint. Defaults to `https://graph.microsoft.com`.
- `sas_token` (String, Sensitive) SAS token for `sas` authentication.
- `storage_endpoint_suffix` (String) Storage endpoint suffix. Defaults to `core.windows.net`.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant ID used by Azure identity authentication. Optional when the ambient Azure credential can infer it.
